notes.title: Monthly update plan
notes.content:
Dear players, hello! Today, we bring you the update plan for "Inkighter"!

Version V0.1.0.0 will be updated in mid to late August and will include the following content:

English Localization Update: After the update, the game will fully support English localization, including interface and subtitles.
Arcade Mode: A new game mode will be available for everyone to challenge.
Training Mode: In this mode, you can choose the playable characters you want to practice with and select training opponents to practice moves and tactics.
New Playable Characters: Players will be able to experience two playable enemy characters currently under testing in the upcoming Training Mode!
Visual Upgrades: We will implement extensive visuals and effect updates to give the game a whole new visual experience!
Bug Fixes: Several known issues will be fixed.

Additionally, the V0.2.0.0 version is expected to be updated in mid-September and is expected to include the following content:

Japanese Localization
Local Multiplayer Mode
PVP Mode
Visual Updates
Thank you for your patience, and please continue to support "Inkighter"!
